description: This Java class defines an abstract Compare class with various concrete subclasses implementing different comparison operations such as equals, greater than, less than, contains, and null or emptiness checks. It manages comparison operations for the minilang framework within the OfBiz project, providing a flexible way to perform comparisons based on operator strings.

classes.name: Compare
classes.description: Abstract base class for comparisons, providing a factory method and abstract comparison method.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a Compare instance for a specified operator string.

methods.name: doCompare
methods.description: Abstract method to perform the comparison, implemented by subclasses.

classes.name: CompareContains
classes.description: Checks if the l-value contains the r-value, either as a collection or as substring.

methods.name: doCompare
methods.description: Implements contains logic for collection or string types.

classes.name: CompareEquals
classes.description: Checks if the l-value is equal to the r-value, with type conversion.

methods.name: doCompare
methods.description: Implements equality comparison with type conversion.

classes.name: CompareGreater
classes.description: Checks if the l-value is greater than the r-value, with type conversion.

methods.name: doCompare
methods.description: Implements greater-than comparison for comparable types.

classes.name: CompareGreaterEquals
classes.description: Checks if the l-value is greater than or equal to the r-value.

classes.name: CompareIsEmpty
classes.description: Checks if the l-value is empty.

methods.name: doCompare
methods.description: Returns true if the converted l-value is empty.

classes.name: CompareIsNotNull
classes.description: Checks if the l-value is not null.

methods.name: doCompare
methods.description: Returns true if the converted l-value is not null.

classes.name: CompareIsNull
classes.description: Checks if the l-value is null.

methods.name: doCompare
methods.description: Returns true if the converted l-value is null.

classes.name: CompareLess
classes.description: Checks if the l-value is less than the r-value.

methods.name: doCompare
methods.description: Implements less-than comparison for comparable types.

classes.name: CompareLessEquals
classes.description: Checks if the l-value is less than or equal to the r-value.

classes.name: CompareNotEquals
classes.description: Checks if the l-value is not equal to the r-value.

methods.name: doCompare
methods.description: Implements inequality comparison with type conversion.
